pages.text: The house is warm and quiet. Mim the little tabby kitten is not sleepy. Not one bit.
The big ginger tom is asleep in the armchair. Mim tiptoes on.
The fluffy white Persian is asleep in a basket, like a cloud with ears.
The sleek Siamese is asleep on the radiator, warm as toast.
The black cat is asleep on the piano. Shh, don't wake the keys.
The calico cat is asleep on the stairs, one paw hanging down.
The enormous Maine Coon is asleep across the whole doormat.
The old barn cat is asleep in the hay by the back door.
Mim finds the kitchen. The milk bowl is empty. The clock goes tick, tock.
Mim finds the window. The moon looks in. "Hello, moon," says Mim.
Mim yawns a very small yawn. Then a bigger one.
Mim curls up in the ginger tom's warm armchair. Goodnight, kittens.
